criteria: Hard constraints and safety first: fail any applicable rule or unresolved hazardous load path and do not advance hardware.
Compare expected successful contribution, cycle time, consistency, alliance fit and development effort using measurements; weights await school priorities.
Prefer bounded scope only provisionally when team resources, alliance role and prototype evidence are unknown. No fabricated weighted score.

capabilities.requirement: Cancel autonomous demand at 15 s; physical stopping distance remains unmeasured.
capabilities.acceptance: Desktop test crosses deadline; all modeled voltage/release requests cancel.

capabilities.requirement: Reviewed zone and alignment valid; loss of validity prevents release.
capabilities.acceptance: Inject invalid/unknown state while ready and assert no feed.
capabilities.evidence: SeasonCaseTest.misalignmentBlocksRelease; gate is injected, not a validated field sensor

capabilities.requirement: Place at a reviewed low-level target with retention and alignment gating; resolve actual field reach before sizing.
capabilities.acceptance: Measure task success over repeated representative trials and confirm field geometry, loads and guard conditions.
capabilities.evidence: OPEN: teaching plant does not validate this capability

capabilities.requirement: Average service rate at least 0.067 pieces/s over the assumed usable interval; at most 15.000 s per piece on average.
capabilities.acceptance: Demonstrate 4 successful deliveries in 60 s with acquisition, transit, alignment and recovery included where applicable.
capabilities.evidence: OPEN: arithmetic requirement, no measured throughput or match-score forecast

capabilities.requirement: Resolve electrical protection, physical retention, guarding, load paths and inspection requirements before hardware.
capabilities.acceptance: Document component-specific ratings, rule review, load/energy analysis and supervised physical checks.
capabilities.evidence: OPEN: no hardware or manufacturing approval

sensitivity.example: If alliance coverage requires upper levels, derive actual field-relative reach and chassis stability first; add homing, travel limits, lift/wrist collision sequencing and gravity restraint. A 0.3 m teaching target is not field reach.

numericAlternative.meaning: Half the usable time doubles required average service rate; feasibility is unresolved.
